_note: Ranges for the annex pass on the praxeo run of cases/we013_halvern (fictional Halvern Steel Safeguard Order). Only tax_rate and import_share rest on the case record; every other range is ILLUSTRATIVE and must be sourced before this annex means anything.

tax_rate.source: WE-013 K1: 25% of the customs value

import_share.source: WE-013 record: domestic firms supply about 60% of use, so imports are about 40% (range for rounding)

demand_elasticity.source: illustrative medium-run elasticity of steel demand

supply_elasticity.source: illustrative medium-run elasticity of domestic steel supply from spare and idle capacity

pass_through.source: illustrative: share of the tariff in the domestic price (1 for a small buyer on the world market; less if foreign sellers absorb part)

input_price_change.source: illustrative: tariff of 25% times pass-through of 0.6 to 1.0

cost_share.source: illustrative: steel's share of construction costs
